d: Magnus Carlsen has never been a conventional world champion, and his latest decision has once again put his personality, sporting values and relationship with chess under the spotlight. The Norwegian grandmaster refused to play Bibisara Assaubayeva in a Fast Classical game after already winning their match, triggering criticism from across the chess world. Is Magnus Carlsen simply playing by the rules, or does a champion have a responsibility beyond the rulebook? Rupha Ramani unpacks the controversy, the backlash and the Carlsen way of doing things.
